image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a stack of baby bibs. The primary subject is a pale pink fabric bib with a rounded shape, featuring embroidered floral patterns (yellow flowers, green leaves) and small decorative motifs. It has a visible neck hole with pink piping/trim. Behind it are other bibs: one white with a printed design and a clear plastic pocket, and a dark brown one with white polka dots and a green snap button at the bottom.

To assess the realism of the fabric folds, lighting shadows, and depth of field, ensuring the stacking looks physically plausible.
